assets.title: Coffea arabica — Köhler's Medizinal-Pflanzen
assets.author: Franz Eugen Köhler (attribution on the Wikimedia Commons file page)
assets.note: Arabica coffee branch with leaves, white flowers, fruits and botanical detail studies on white paper. Historical plate dated 1883–1914 by Commons; its attribution is to the publication, not a separately identified illustrator. Downloaded original 1572 × 2168 px; resized proportionally to 1160 × 1600 px and JPEG-encoded at quality 91, without cropping or color adjustment. The Commons source is already retouched. Commons marks the work public domain under life-plus-70 terms; publication before 1931 also places the historical artwork in the US public domain.

assets.title: Vitis vinifera — Köhler's Medizinal-Pflanzen, plate 51 (1887)

assets.note: Grapevine with a green grape cluster, lobed leaves, curling tendrils and botanical detail studies on warm aged paper. Faithful scan from the Missouri Botanical Garden's Rare Books Collection via BHL, page 303664. Downloaded original 2905 × 4033 px; resized proportionally to 1152 × 1600 px and JPEG-encoded at quality 91, without cropping or color adjustment. Catalog attribution covers the publication's contributors rather than a separately identified plate illustrator. Commons explicitly applies PD-scan with PD-old-70-1923.
